def max_piece_volume(n, h, v):
    # Calculate the thickness of each piece
    height_top = min(h, n - h)
    height_bottom = n - height_top
    
    width_left = min(v, n - v)
    width_right = n - width_left
    
    # The largest piece will be the one with the maximum height and width
    largest_height = max(height_top, height_bottom)
    largest_width = max(width_left, width_right)
    
    # Volume of the largest piece
    return largest_height * largest_width * 4

    # Find the maximum volume among the four pieces
    max_volume = max(piece1, piece2, piece3, piece4)
    
    return max_volume
